tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search listed Dealpuffin offers by query and/or category, or pass id for one offer. Omits promotion codes. Includes public proof points on the product.

tools.name: reveal_offer
tools.description: Reveal the promotion code for one listed offer. One claim per user per coupon; repeats return the same assigned code. With several codes, Dealpuffin round-robins eligible codes on first reveal.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read one product listing: copy, logo, video_url, screenshots, public proof points, reviews, and verification_status. Public https listings (pending or verified) are readable. Owners also receive DNS and HTTP ownership instructions when pending, plus free_for_now.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List categories and subcategories. Product create and update use subcategory slugs (rows with a parent). other-software fits products with no better match.

tools.name: list_wishes
tools.description: List wishes for demand signal. Pass category for open wishes (parent includes subcategories). Pass product for wishes on that listing. Pass mine true for wishes on products this account owns; mine may also take category or product.

tools.name: list_my_coupons
tools.description: List coupons imported for one of your products, with codes and why each is listed or held back.

tools.name: submit_product
tools.description: Create a product listing from its public URL and a subcategory. Name, title, description, logo, video_url (first YouTube/Vimeo/Loom link), and up to 5 screenshots are filled from the page when omitted; screenshots takes [{ data }] (base64 or data URL) and [] skips autofill, video_url empty string sk

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Update one of your listings. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. screenshots replaces the full set when present: { id } keeps a shot from get_product, or { data } uploads base64 / a data URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; max 5; 10 MB). Empty screenshots clears them. video_url empty string clears the video.

tools.name: connect_coupon_provider
tools.description: Connect or replace a billing read key on one product and import coupons, or omit token to import again with the stored key. provider is stripe (rk_), paddle (pdl_* with discount.read), polar (polar_oat_ with discounts:read), lemon-squeezy (API key; store_id when more than one store), dodo-payments (

tools.name: publish_coupon
tools.description: Publish or unpublish one imported coupon on its product. published defaults to true. Optional claim_limit sets a Dealpuffin cap at or below the billing provider max.

tools.name: connect_proof_point
tools.description: Connect or replace a proof-point provider on one product and run the first read. MRR providers: stripe, paddle, polar, revenuecat, lemon-squeezy, dodo-payments. Uptime: betterstack, cloudwatch, gcp-monitoring. Traffic: google-analytics. cadence is daily, weekly, or monthly. points list field_name an

tools.name: update_proof_config
tools.description: Change proof-point configuration on one of your products after connect. action is sync (re-read), disconnect (remove provider), cadence (set daily/weekly/monthly), mode (exact, band, or hidden on one point), or order (move one point up or down).

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Post a review on a product (stars 1–5 and body), or pass review_id to reply to an existing review on that product.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send a feature request, issue, or friction report about Dealpuffin. Omit billing keys and promotion codes.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "connect_proof_point" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Connect or replace a proof-point provider on one product and run the first read. MRR providers: stripe, paddle, polar, revenuecat, lemon-squeezy, dodo-payments.…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product · Private data: update_product, connect_coupon_provider, connect_proof_point · Public sink: submit_product, connect_coupon_provider, publish_coupon, create_review, submit_feedback · Destructive: connect_proof_point, update_proof_config.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product · Private data: update_product, connect_coupon_provider, connect_proof_point · Public sink: submit_product, connect_coupon_provider, publish_coupon, create_review, submit_feedback · Destructive: connect_proof_point, update_proof_config

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
